annotations.title: Record what was done with a suggested edit

description: Records that the person applied or declined a suggestion (the proposal_id from edit_job_proposal), with the time. The same proposal_id again answers what was recorded and changes nothing, so a retry is safe.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

job_id.description: A suggestion job (edit_job_open with suggest: true)

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: edit_job_proposal_settle
title: Record what was done with a suggested edit
